notes.title: A Much-Needed Update on Unfriendly Friend
notes.content:
Hey, friends!

We wanted to give you a quick but important update. The full version of Unfriendly Friend is in the works, and we're hoping to release it this autumn!

Stay tuned, as we'll be sharing more info as we get closer to the release. 


Thank you so much for being with us. I honestly never expected so many people to play Unfriendly Friend, and it means the world that so many of you are waiting for the full release. You are amazing. Thank you, truly.


Have a great day!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301949/6ad7d94ba02513e720e28d47d53b36335cb729f2.png"]

notes.title: Demo is Released!
notes.content:
Hi! I am here with some great news—we’ve finally uploaded our demo to Steam, and we’re participating in Steam Next Fest!

I highly recommend playing the demo to get a feel for the game. But if you’d rather wait and play the full version, that’s totally fine too!

I’m really excited to hear your feedback—do you like the game? What could be improved? Did you encounter any bugs?

If you find any bugs, please report them in the discussion here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301949/3b0b3fecf8af5388db433b917c75e2f13a1dd1fa.gif
I truly appreciate any help and feedback. Thank you so much for your support—we’ll keep working hard on the game!

If you have any questions or want to submit feedback, feel free to email us at: unfriendlyfrienddemo@gmail.com

Have a great day, and stay safe!

notes.title: DEMO – FEBRUARY 21
notes.content:
Hey, betetiro here. We have some great news!
The demo is finally coming out on February 21. It’s been a long journey, but we made it!

As you may have noticed, we’ve updated the Steam page, and we’ll continue improving it as we get closer to release.

I also want to mention that the demo will include only a limited set of features. The full version will have more interactive elements, puzzles, and an improved inventory system.

We really hope you’ll enjoy playing the game. We’ve put a lot of effort into it, and it would mean a lot if you liked it. Thank you so much for your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301949/3b0b3fecf8af5388db433b917c75e2f13a1dd1fa.gif

The demo may have some bugs or issues, so if you have any feedback, feel free to send it to: unfriendlyfrienddemo@gmail.com.
We’ll also create a discussion thread with more details later.

That’s all for now—thanks for your attention! I hope you have a great day.

See you on February 21!
